status_semantics.covered: The requested audit item is explicitly represented in the input set and can be traced to a bounded evidence source.
status_semantics.partial: The item is present, but its original behavior, exact schema, ordering, ownership, or OpenSpore implementation remains bounded or incomplete.
status_semantics.missing: The requested original behavior or evidence is absent from the input set and must not be synthesized without new evidence.

prohibited_scope_checks.claim: Current OpenSpore behavior is runtime-equivalent to the original game.
Every original file format or wire order is known exactly.
A literal original EditorData type or wire format was recovered.
The exact saved-game container, slots, profiles, migration, and transaction are known.
One universal original entity/object ABI governs every mode.
All events share one universal original ABI.
Decompiled source may be copied or reproduced.
Proprietary assets, SDK source, models, textures, sounds, or scripts may be added.
SPORE/ may be inspected or modified for this audit.
Ghidra or the analysis database may be mutated for this audit.
Historical artifacts 01-18 may be silently corrected during this audit.
Host pointers or preserved dead pointer-shaped values are original live pointers.
ResourceKey fields can be serialized as an unlabelled positional triple.
Direct Cell content records are save state or a generic CellSerializer envelope.
Current GMDL support is complete across versions, trailers, or animation.
RW4 structural completeness means payload or type-code semantics are known.
Generated Cell fixtures or state strings are original-game or save/load oracles.
SDK names, comments, or static anchors alone prove exact runtime behavior.
Deterministic output of OpenSpore proves deterministic or equivalent original behavior.
The modern Vulkan renderer matches original RenderWare materials, lighting, animation, effects, UI, or pixels.
0x00E4CE20 is GetGlobalsData.
0x0F43029A is verified per-entity Cell placement data.
growMeter is original evolution points, unlocked parts, or empire money.
WorldObject Python vectors are byte-exact fields.

Map every artifact, requested domain, semantic-mapping field, schema node, major relationship, persistence/lifecycle transition, save/load entry point, OpenSpore comparison, final-report section, package boundary, and required question.

Preserve contradictions and unresolved requirements rather than inventing a complete original model.

determinism.array_order: ID, path, package, reference, and priority collections are lexicographically sorted; narrative arrays use a fixed authored sequence and are not sets.

limitations: This audit adds no new original evidence and does not inspect SPORE/ or mutate Ghidra.
Covered means the requested item is mapped in the input set, not that original runtime behavior is fully reconstructed.
Partial and missing statuses preserve the strongest unresolved original boundaries.
The final report must use the exact represented, partial, missing, incorrect, and intentional-modern-divergence classifications from artifact 18.
No final report may claim complete save/load, exact original formats, universal event/entity ABI, original procedural placement, or runtime equivalence.
